reasoning: The earlier answer 51.97 is mathematically correct to the requested precision. Using the supplied inverse value gives μ=50.396 and z=(50−50.396)/8=−0.0495, so P(X>50)≈0.5197396, or 51.97%. Using the exact inverse normal value also rounds to 51.97%. Math Academy rejected the submitted 51.97 and states 51.99 in its worked solution. Its discrepancy comes from prematurely rounding z to −0.05 before the table lookup; 51.99 is a table approximation, not the probability correctly rounded to two decimal places.

answers.ma_evidence: Therefore, approximately $51.99%$ of the trees are taller than $50$ feet.
